questions.question: What solemn warning is repeated in Amos 4?
options: 'Prepare to meet your God, O Israel'
questions.answer: 'Prepare to meet your God, O Israel'

questions.question: Despite many disasters God sent, what did Israel fail to do?
options: Seek him (repeated refrain: 'yet you did not find me')
Rejoice in him (repeated refrain: 'yet you still did not praise me')
Return to him (repeated refrain: 'yet you did not return to me')
Fear him (repeated refrain: 'yet you did not tremble')
questions.answer: Return to him (repeated refrain: 'yet you did not return to me')

questions.question: Amos 4 condemns the wealthy women of Samaria, calling them 'cows of Bashan.'
Prepare to meet your _____, O Israel!
Yet you did not return to me, declares the _____.
